explication: GameNative is an Android app for installing and running owned PC games locally, with library access across several stores, cloud saves, compatibility configuration, and touch/controller support. The principal flow is account/library access, game installation, setup in a compatibility container, then launch through the native runtime. The graph includes documented capabilities whose implementations are not represented in the sampled excerpts; those paths and connections are kept broad where the tree or excerpts do not establish exact wiring.
